# Design System Token Contract

Every design theme.css must define these CSS custom properties for shared components to work correctly.

## Colors (17)

| Token                   | Purpose                            |
| ----------------------- | ---------------------------------- |
| `--design-bg`           | Page background                    |
| `--design-fg`           | Primary text color                 |
| `--design-card`         | Card/surface background            |
| `--design-card-fg`      | Card text color                    |
| `--design-primary`      | Brand/accent color                 |
| `--design-primary-fg`   | Text on primary backgrounds        |
| `--design-secondary`    | Secondary surfaces                 |
| `--design-secondary-fg` | Text on secondary surfaces         |
| `--design-muted`        | Subdued backgrounds                |
| `--design-muted-fg`     | Subdued text                       |
| `--design-accent`       | Highlight/accent color             |
| `--design-accent-fg`    | Text on accent backgrounds         |
| `--design-destructive`  | Error/danger color                 |
| `--design-warning`      | Warning/caution color (amber/gold) |
| `--design-border`       | Border color                       |
| `--design-input`        | Input background                   |
| `--design-ring`         | Focus ring color                   |

## Radii (4)

| Token                | Typical Value |
| -------------------- | ------------- |
| `--design-radius-sm` | `0.25rem`     |
| `--design-radius-md` | `0.375rem`    |
| `--design-radius-lg` | `0.5rem`      |
| `--design-radius-xl` | `1rem`        |

## Spacing (7)

| Token                  | Value     | Pixels |
| ---------------------- | --------- | ------ |
| `--design-spacing-xs`  | `0.25rem` | 4px    |
| `--design-spacing-sm`  | `0.5rem`  | 8px    |
| `--design-spacing-md`  | `1rem`    | 16px   |
| `--design-spacing-lg`  | `1.5rem`  | 24px   |
| `--design-spacing-xl`  | `2rem`    | 32px   |
| `--design-spacing-2xl` | `3rem`    | 48px   |
| `--design-spacing-3xl` | `4rem`    | 64px   |

## Z-Index Layers (7)

| Token                 | Value | Purpose                             |
| --------------------- | ----- | ----------------------------------- |
| `--design-z-base`     | `0`   | Default layer                       |
| `--design-z-dropdown` | `10`  | Dropdown menus                      |
| `--design-z-sticky`   | `20`  | Sticky nav, pinned elements         |
| `--design-z-overlay`  | `30`  | Backdrop overlays                   |
| `--design-z-modal`    | `40`  | Dialogs, lightbox                   |
| `--design-z-popover`  | `50`  | Tooltips, popovers on top of modals |
| `--design-z-toast`    | `60`  | Toast notifications, always on top  |

## Fonts (3, set via next/font)

| Token                     | Purpose                         |
| ------------------------- | ------------------------------- |
| `--font-design-primary`   | Body text font family           |
| `--font-design-secondary` | Heading font family             |
| `--font-design-mono`      | Monospace / eyebrow font family |

Fonts are injected by the gallery app layout via `next/font` and are NOT defined in theme.css.

## Usage

Components reference tokens via `var(--design-*)`. CSS `color-mix()` is used for transparency where needed. All color mixing uses `in oklch` color space.

See `src/token-contract.css` for a commented placeholder template.

## Interaction Language

Components follow a three-state interaction progression:

**neutral → accent (hover/anticipation) → primary (active/selected/committed)**

| State              | Token                                              | When                               |
| ------------------ | -------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------- |
| Neutral/default    | `--design-muted`, `--design-border`, `--design-fg` | Element at rest                    |
| Hover/anticipation | `--design-accent`                                  | Mouse hover, keyboard focus nearby |
| Active/selected    | `--design-primary` + `--design-primary-fg`         | Clicked, selected, toggled on      |

### Token Pairings

| Interaction            | Background                                     | Text                    | Border             |
| ---------------------- | ---------------------------------------------- | ----------------------- | ------------------ |
| Default button         | `--design-primary`                             | `--design-primary-fg`   | none               |
| Default button hover   | `--design-accent`                              | `--design-accent-fg`    | none               |
| Secondary button       | `--design-secondary`                           | `--design-secondary-fg` | none               |
| Secondary button hover | `color-mix(--design-accent, transparent 85%)`  | `--design-accent-fg`    | none               |
| Chip default           | transparent                                    | `--design-muted-fg`     | `--design-border`  |
| Chip hover             | transparent                                    | `--design-accent`       | `--design-accent`  |
| Chip active            | `color-mix(--design-primary, transparent 10%)` | `--design-primary`      | `--design-primary` |
| Nav link               | none                                           | `--design-muted-fg`     | none               |
| Nav link hover         | none                                           | `--design-accent`       | none               |

# UI/UX Revamp Plan — Kspec Web UI

**Task:** @01KJXQK4
**Status:** Active
**Date:** 2026-03-04

---

## 0. Development Workflow

All UI revamp work happens in an **isolated clone** of the repo on a long-lived feature branch. This prevents in-progress UI work from affecting the main working copy.

### Setup

```bash
# Clone to a separate directory
git clone /home/chapel/Projects/kynetic-spec /home/chapel/Projects/kynetic-spec-ui
cd /home/chapel/Projects/kynetic-spec-ui

# Create the feature branch
git checkout -b feat/ui-revamp

# Bootstrap
node scripts/bootstrap.cjs

# Initialize kspec (creates .kspec/ worktree pointing to same kspec-meta branch)
kspec init
```

### Work Rules

1. **All code changes** happen in `/home/chapel/Projects/kynetic-spec-ui` on `feat/ui-revamp`
2. **Task tracking** uses kspec from either location — both share the same `kspec-meta` shadow branch
3. **Commits** go to `feat/ui-revamp` with conventional commit format + task trailers
4. **Periodic rebases** from `main` to stay current: `git fetch origin main && git rebase origin/main`
5. **Sub-branches** for individual tasks branch off `feat/ui-revamp`: `git checkout -b feat/ui-revamp/phase-1-tokens`
6. **PRs** target `main` from the feature branch (or sub-branches for smaller merges)
7. **Daemon API changes** that are prerequisites should be PRed to `main` first, then rebased into the UI branch

### Directory Layout

```
~/Projects/
├── kynetic-spec/           # Main working copy (main branch, day-to-day work)
│   └── .kspec/             # Shadow branch (kspec-meta) — shared state
└── kynetic-spec-ui/        # UI revamp clone (feat/ui-revamp branch)
    └── .kspec/             # Same shadow branch — tasks visible from both
```

### When to Merge

Each phase produces a mergeable increment. PR to `main` when:
- Phase deliverable is complete
- All E2E tests pass
- Existing functionality is preserved (progressive enhancement)
- No regressions in current views

---

## 1. Vision & Goals

Transform the kspec web UI from a functional but basic dashboard into a polished, comprehensive interface that:

- Exposes **all** kspec features through intuitive navigation
- Provides real-time visibility into agent work (dispatch, sessions, streaming output)
- Uses a kanban-style task dashboard with active work prominence
- Delivers a professional, non-"AI slop" design built from imgen's proven design system
- Supports both power users (keyboard navigation, command palette) and casual viewing

### Non-Goals
- Drag-and-drop kanban (tasks transition via agents/CLI, not manual dragging)
- Mobile-first design (desktop primary, responsive secondary)
- Replacing the CLI (UI complements CLI, doesn't replace it)

---

## 2. Design System: Porting from imgen

### 2.1 Token Architecture

Port imgen's `token-contract.css` to establish the foundation:

```
design-bg, design-fg, design-surface, design-border
design-primary, design-accent, design-muted
design-ring (focus), design-radius, design-shadow
```

**Color space:** oklch() for perceptual uniformity and wide gamut support.

**Dark theme baseline (from imgen Design 27/28):**
- Background: `oklch(0.12-0.15 0.01 250)` — deep blue-charcoal
- Surface: `oklch(0.16-0.20 0.01 250)` — card/panel backgrounds
- Border: `oklch(0.24-0.26 0.015 250)` — subtle dividers
- Primary: `oklch(0.58 0.22 25)` — signal red (or adapt to kspec brand)
- Accent: `oklch(0.7 0.2 145)` — green for success/active states
- Muted text: `oklch(0.55 0.02 60)` — secondary content

**Status color mapping (from kynetic-internal, adapted to oklch):**

| Status | Color token | Usage |
|--------|------------|-------|
| pending | amber | Waiting, queued |
| in_progress | orange | Active work |
| pending_review | blue | Review needed |
| needs_work | yellow | Fix cycle |
| completed | emerald | Done |
| blocked | red | Cannot proceed |
| cancelled | zinc/gray | Archived |

### 2.2 Typography

From imgen's system:
- **3 font families** via CSS custom properties (primary, secondary, mono)
- **Fluid sizing** with `clamp()` for headlines
- **Eyebrow text:** `0.75rem`, uppercase, `letter-spacing: 0.08em`, accent color
- **Headlines:** `clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 2.25rem)`, tight tracking (`-0.02em`)
- **Body:** `0.875-1rem`, `line-height: 1.5-1.6`
- **Mono** (for ULIDs, code, agent output): system mono or JetBrains Mono

### 2.3 Component Naming

Follow imgen's `ds-` prefix convention:
- `.ds-card`, `.ds-badge`, `.ds-button`, `.ds-input`
- Status variants via data attributes: `[data-status="in_progress"]`
- All components scoped to avoid leaking

### 2.4 Animations & Motion

Port from imgen:
- **Breathing/pulse** for active agent work (`.ds-gen-breathe`)
- **Shimmer** for loading skeletons
- **Entrance animations** with stagger for list items (blur + translateY)
- **All gated** behind `prefers-reduced-motion`

---

## 3. Information Architecture

### 3.1 Navigation Structure

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ [Logo] kspec          [Search ⌘K]  [Connection] │
├──────────┬──────────────────────────────────────┤
│ Sidebar  │                                      │
│          │  Main Content Area                   │
│ Dashboard│                                      │
│ Tasks    │                                      │
│ Specs    │                                      │
│ Agents   │                                      │
│ Sessions │                                      │
│ Inbox    │                                      │
│ Observe  │                                      │
│ Triage   │                                      │
│ Plans    │                                      │
│ ──────── │                                      │
│ Validate │                                      │
│ Search   │                                      │
│ Settings │                                      │
└──────────┴──────────────────────────────────────┘
```

**Sidebar:** Collapsible icon rail (like kynetic-internal's ProjectSidebar). Each section has an icon + label. Badge counts for actionable items (inbox count, unresolved observations, pending review tasks).

**Header:** Project name, command palette trigger, connection status indicator, project selector (multi-project).

### 3.2 Page Hierarchy

```
/                      → Dashboard (overview)
/tasks                 → Task board (kanban)
/tasks?ref=@slug       → Task board with detail modal open
/specs                 → Spec tree browser
/specs?ref=@slug       → Spec tree with detail panel
/agents                → Agent definitions + dispatch status
/agents/dispatch       → Live dispatch view
/sessions              → Session history list
/sessions/:id          → Session detail (chat log)
/inbox                 → Inbox items
/observations          → Observations (friction/success/question/idea)
/triage                → Triage workflow
/plans                 → Plan records
/validate              → Validation results + alignment
/search                → Dedicated search (also via ⌘K)
```

---

## 4. View Designs

### 4.1 Dashboard (Home)

The dashboard is a high-level overview, not a working view. It answers: "What's happening right now?"

```
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ ACTIVE WORK                                            │
│ ┌──────────────┐ ┌──────────────┐ ┌──────────────┐    │
│ │ ● Task Title │ │ ● Task Title │ │              │    │
│ │ agent: worker│ │ agent: worker│ │  No active   │    │
│ │ ▓▓▓▓▓▓▓░░░░ │ │ ▓▓▓░░░░░░░░ │ │  work        │    │
│ │ 12m elapsed  │ │ 3m elapsed   │ │              │    │
│ └──────────────┘ └──────────────┘ └──────────────┘    │
├────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ ┌─────────┐ ┌─────────┐ ┌─────────┐ ┌─────────┐      │
│ │ Pending │ │ In Prog │ │ Review  │ │ Done    │      │
│ │   12    │ │    3    │ │    2    │ │   47    │      │
│ └─────────┘ └─────────┘ └─────────┘ └─────────┘      │
├────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ RECENT ACTIVITY               │ NEEDS ATTENTION        │
│ ● task-foo completed (2m ago) │ 5 inbox items untriaged│
│ ● task-bar started (5m ago)   │ 3 observations pending │
│ ● PR #42 merged (12m ago)     │ 1 validation warning   │
│ ● task-baz reviewed (15m ago) │ 2 blocked tasks        │
└───────────────────────────────┴────────────────────────┘
```

**Active Work Row:** Prominently displayed at top. Cards show:
- Task title + slug
- Assigned agent
- Time elapsed (breathing animation border)
- Mini output preview (last 2-3 lines of agent output, like kynetic-internal's MiniTerminal)
- Click → opens session stream view

**Status Summary:** Clickable cards that navigate to filtered task views.

**Recent Activity:** Timeline of last N events from session logs.

**Needs Attention:** Aggregated actionable items with direct links.

### 4.2 Task Board (Kanban)

This is the primary working view, inspired by kynetic-internal but adapted for kspec's workflow.

```
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ ACTIVE FLEET (only when agents are working)                │
│ ┌───────────────────┐ ┌───────────────────┐                │
│ │ ● @task-auth      │ │ ● @task-deploy    │                │
│ │ task-worker       │ │ task-worker       │                │
│ │ > Running tests.. │ │ > Editing src/..  │                │
│ │ ▰▰▰▰▰▰▱▱▱▱       │ │ ▰▰▰▱▱▱▱▱▱▱       │                │
│ └───────────────────┘ └───────────────────┘                │
├────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ Backlog      │ In Progress  │ Review       │ Done          │
│ ┌──────────┐ │ ┌──────────┐ │ ┌──────────┐ │ ┌──────────┐ │
│ │ Task     │ │ │ Task     │ │ │ Task     │ │ │ Task     │ │
│ │ P1 ● cli│ │ │ P2 ● web│ │ │ PR #42   │ │ │ ✓ merged │ │
│ │ @ref     │ │ │ @ref     │ │ │ @ref     │ │ │ @ref     │ │
│ └──────────┘ │ └──────────┘ │ └──────────┘ │ └──────────┘ │
│ ┌──────────┐ │              │              │ ┌──────────┐ │
│ │ Task     │ │              │              │ │ Task     │ │
│ │ P2 ● sch│ │              │              │ │ ✓ merged │ │
│ └──────────┘ │              │              │ └──────────┘ │
└──────────────┴──────────────┴──────────────┴──────────────┘
```

**Column mapping:**

| Column | Task statuses |
|--------|--------------|
| Backlog | `pending` (automation: unassessed, manual_only) |
| Ready | `pending` (automation: eligible) — ready for pickup |
| In Progress | `in_progress`, `needs_work` |
| Review | `pending_review` |
| Done | `completed` (recent, last 7 days) |
| Blocked | `blocked` (separate section or inline indicator) |

**Active Fleet Row** (from kynetic-internal pattern):
- Only visible when dispatch agents are actively working
- Shows real-time mini terminal output per task
- Breathing animation on card borders
- Click → expands to full session stream

**Task Card Design:**
```
┌─────────────────────────┐
│ P1  ● cli  ◆ eligible   │  ← priority, tag chips, automation badge
│ Fix validation edge case │  ← title
│ @task-fix-validation     │  ← slug (monospace, muted)
│ Spec: @item-validation   │  ← spec ref link
│ ─────────────────────── │
│ 2 notes · 1 dep · 3h ago│  ← metadata footer
└─────────────────────────┘
```

**Task Detail Modal** (click card → modal):
- Full task information: title, description, status, priority, type
- Status badge with transition history
- Spec reference (clickable, shows spec detail inline)
- Tags (editable)
- Dependencies + blocked-by (with status indicators)
- Notes (chronological, with author + timestamp)
- Todos (if any)
- Automation eligibility
- Session history (links to session view)
- Actions: Start, Submit, Complete, Block, Add Note (when daemon connected)

### 4.3 Spec Browser

Hierarchical tree with detail panel, enhanced from current implementation.

```
┌──────────────────────┬─────────────────────────────────────┐
│ SPEC TREE            │ DETAIL                              │
│                      │                                     │
│ ▼ core               │ Feature: User Authentication        │
│   ▼ authentication   │ @user-auth                          │
│     ● login          │ ─────────────────────────────────── │
│     ● session-mgmt   │ Description:                        │
│   ▼ tasks            │ Users can authenticate via...       │
│     ● lifecycle      │                                     │
│     ● automation     │ Acceptance Criteria:                 │
│ ▼ web-ui             │ ┌─────────────────────────────────┐ │
│   ● dashboard        │ │ AC-1: Login flow         ✓ 3/3  │ │
│   ● task-board       │ │ Given: valid credentials        │ │
│ ▼ agents             │ │ When: user submits login        │ │
│   ● dispatch         │ │ Then: session is created        │ │
│   ● invocation       │ ├─────────────────────────────────┤ │
│                      │ │ AC-2: Token refresh      ✕ 0/2  │ │
│                      │ │ ...                             │ │
│                      │ └─────────────────────────────────┘ │
│                      │                                     │
│                      │ Traits: @trait-validated, @trait-... │
│                      │ Linked Tasks: @task-auth (in_prog)  │
│                      │ Tags: mvp, auth                     │
└──────────────────────┴─────────────────────────────────────┘
```

**Enhancements over current:**
- AC coverage indicators (✓ covered / ✕ not / ? unknown) with count
- Trait AC display (inherited ACs from traits, with N/A annotations)
- Quick navigation between spec ↔ linked tasks
- Inline editing of description, tags (when daemon connected)

### 4.4 Agent & Dispatch View

New view. Shows agent definitions, dispatch status, and live invocations.

## 6. Real-Time Architecture

### 6.1 WebSocket Topics (Existing + New)

**Existing:**
- `tasks:updates` — task state changes
- `items:updates` — spec changes
- `inbox:updates` — inbox changes
- `meta:updates` — agent/workflow changes
- `validation:updates` — validation state
- `session:updates` — session context

**Needed for new views:**
- `dispatch:updates` — dispatch start/stop, invocation lifecycle
- `session:stream:{id}` — per-session streaming events (tool calls, messages)
- `triage:updates` — triage record changes (already exists)

### 6.2 Session Streaming

For the session stream view, we need to either:
1. **Read session event files** (`.kspec/sessions/{id}/events.jsonl`) via API polling
2. **Stream via WebSocket** — daemon publishes session events to topic

The daemon likely needs enhancement to support option 2 for true real-time streaming. In the interim, option 1 with polling (every 1-2s for active sessions) provides adequate UX.

**For dispatch agent output streaming:**
The dispatch engine spawns agents as subprocesses. To stream their output:
- Daemon captures stdout/stderr from spawned agents
- Publishes as `session:stream:{id}` WebSocket events
- UI subscribes to active session streams
- Falls back to event log polling if WS unavailable

## 9. Key Design Decisions

### 9.1 No Drag-and-Drop Kanban
Tasks transition via agents and CLI commands, not manual dragging. The board is a **visualization**, not a manipulation tool. Users can trigger transitions via buttons in the detail modal (Start, Submit, Complete, Block).

### 9.2 Active Work Prominence
The Active Fleet row at the top of the task board (and condensed on the dashboard) ensures current agent work is always visible. This addresses the key question: "What are my agents doing right now?"

### 9.3 Session Stream as Primary Agent View
Rather than trying to replicate a terminal, the session stream uses rich message components (like kynetic-internal's ChatPanel) with markdown rendering, collapsible tool calls, and thinking blocks. This is more readable than raw terminal output.

### 9.4 Design System Independence
The DS layer (`lib/ds/`) should have zero dependency on kspec business logic. Components are pure presentational. This allows the design system to evolve independently and potentially be extracted.

### 9.5 Progressive Enhancement
The UI works in both live (daemon connected) and static (snapshot) modes. Write operations are disabled in static mode with clear indicators. This is already implemented but must be maintained through the revamp.

## 11. Review Findings & Revisions

Critical review performed after initial draft. The following issues were identified and their resolutions documented.

### 11.1 CRITICAL: Tailwind vs Custom CSS

**Problem:** The plan originally said "no Tailwind — matches imgen approach." But the entire current web UI is built on Tailwind CSS 4. Every component uses Tailwind classes (`bg-gray-500`, `flex items-center gap-2`). Dependencies include `tailwindcss`, `@tailwindcss/postcss`, `tailwind-merge`, `tailwind-variants`, `tw-animate-css`. Ripping out Tailwind would require rewriting every existing component.

**Resolution: Keep Tailwind, map imgen tokens as Tailwind theme extensions.** The current `app.css` already uses oklch CSS custom properties that Tailwind consumes via `@theme inline`. imgen's token values will be mapped into this existing system. This is the practical path:

```css
/* app.css — map imgen tokens to Tailwind theme */
@theme inline {
  --color-design-bg: oklch(0.13 0.01 250);
  --color-design-surface: oklch(0.18 0.01 250);
  --color-design-border: oklch(0.25 0.015 250);
  --color-design-primary: oklch(0.58 0.22 25);
  --color-design-accent: oklch(0.7 0.2 145);
  /* ... etc */
}
```

Components use Tailwind utilities referencing design tokens: `bg-design-surface`, `border-design-border`, `text-design-accent`. The `ds-` CSS class prefix convention is dropped — not needed since Svelte has built-in component scoping via `<style>` tags.

### 11.2 Missing Views

**Workflows view:** Not included in navigation or routes. Daemon serves `GET /api/meta/workflows`. Users need to see active/completed workflows, trigger workflows, and track progress.

**Resolution:** Add `/workflows` route to section 3.2. Add to sidebar. Components: `WorkflowList.svelte`, `WorkflowDetail.svelte`, `WorkflowStepProgress.svelte`. Store: `workflows.svelte.ts`.

**Conventions view:** No way to browse project conventions. Conventions are a core meta concept.

**Resolution:** Add `/settings` route that includes: conventions browser, agent config, project info, shadow branch health, theme switching, daemon connection config.

**Settings page:** Listed in sidebar wireframe but never defined.

**Resolution:** Settings serves as the "meta" view — conventions, skills, project config, daemon health. Not a priority for Phase 1 but must be planned.

## 12. Codex Review Findings & Resolutions

Codex (gpt-5.3-codex, high reasoning) reviewed the plan against the actual codebase with file-level cross-referencing. 26 findings total.

### 12.1 MUST-FIX: Internal Route Inconsistency

**Finding:** Section 3.2 and Section 11.8 define different route sets.
**Resolution:** Section 11.8 is authoritative. Section 3.2 is the original draft — readers should treat 11.8 as the final route table.

### 12.2 MUST-FIX: Workflow Runs API Missing

**Finding:** Workflow definitions are served (`GET /api/meta/workflows`) but run data (status, current step, progress) has no API.
**Resolution:** Add to Phase 4 daemon work:
- `GET /api/workflows` — list with run status
- `GET /api/workflows/:id` — detail including step history
- Underlying loader exists (`src/parser/meta.ts:1000-1084`), just needs HTTP route.

### 12.3 MUST-FIX: WebSocket Topics Inaccurate

**Finding:** Plan claimed topics that don't exist. Actual topics:
- `tasks:updates` — exists
- `inbox:updates` — exists
- `triage:updates` — exists
- `agents` — exists (dispatch events including `agent_text_chunk`)
- File watcher topics — exist
- `items:updates`, `meta:updates`, `validation:updates`, `session:updates` — **DO NOT EXIST**

**Resolution:** Corrected in plan. New views that need real-time updates for items/meta/validation will either:
(a) Subscribe to file watcher topics and refresh on relevant file changes, or
(b) Poll on a reasonable interval (30s for validation, immediate for user-triggered actions).

### 12.4 MUST-FIX: Session Streaming — Text-Only vs Structured

**Finding:** `agent_text_chunk` events are plain text. The plan's rich wireframe (tool calls, thinking blocks, collapsible output) can't be rendered from text chunks alone.

**Resolution:** Two-tier approach:
1. **Historical sessions:** Read `events.jsonl` via new `GET /api/sessions/:id/events` endpoint. JSONL contains structured events (tool calls, messages, thinking) with full type info.
2. **Live sessions:** Use `agent_text_chunk` for live text streaming (shows raw agent output). For structured view, poll `events.jsonl` periodically (2-3s) to get structured events as they're appended.
3. **Future enhancement:** Daemon could publish structured session events on a dedicated WS topic. This is a daemon feature, not UI work, and can be added later.

The session stream view should support both modes: "Live text" (raw streaming) and "Structured" (parsed from event log). Default to structured for completed sessions, live text for active sessions with periodic structured refresh.

### 12.5 MUST-FIX: `cancelled` Status Missing from Kanban

**Finding:** `cancelled` is a valid task state not mapped to any kanban column.
**Resolution:** Add "Cancelled" handling — cancelled tasks appear in the "Done" column with a distinct visual (strikethrough title, gray badge). They are collapsed by default (like Archive in kynetic-internal) or filterable.

### 12.6 MUST-FIX: Phases Don't Cover New Views

**Finding:** Workflows and Settings were added in section 11 but not assigned to any phase.
**Resolution:**
- **Workflows view:** Phase 4 (alongside Plans and Validation)
- **Settings view:** Phase 4 (minimal: conventions list, project info, shadow health)
- **Settings detail:** Phase 5 (editable conventions, skill management, theme switching)

### 12.7 MUST-FIX: Accessibility Underspecified

**Finding:** Complex modals, live streams, and keyboard-heavy views need concrete accessibility requirements, not just a Phase 5 audit.

**Resolution:** Accessibility requirements per view type:
- **Modals:** Focus trap (bits-ui handles this), escape to close, return focus to trigger
- **Live stream:** `aria-live="polite"` region, pause/resume controls, keyboard scrolling
- **Kanban:** Column landmarks with heading, card announced with status + title
- **Triage:** Keyboard shortcuts with visible hints, `aria-keyshortcuts` attributes
- **Status badges:** Not color-only — include text labels (already done in current UI)
- **All animations:** `prefers-reduced-motion` gated (from imgen convention)

These are per-phase requirements, not deferred to Phase 5.

### 12.8 SHOULD-FIX: Task Detail Missing Schema Fields

**Finding:** Task detail modal wireframe omits `plan_ref`, `review_url`, `vcs_refs`, `session_id`, `context`.
**Resolution:** Updated task detail modal spec:
- **VCS:** Show branch name + PR link (from `vcs_refs` and `review_url`)
- **Plan:** Link to plan (if `plan_ref` set)
- **Session:** Link to last session (if `session_id` set)
- **Context:** Show if present (typically dispatch context)
- `meta_ref` is internal, not displayed

### 12.9 SHOULD-FIX: Spec Detail Missing Relationship Fields

**Finding:** `depends_on`, `implements`, `relates_to`, `traceability` not in wireframe.
**Resolution:** Add "Relationships" section to spec detail panel showing:
- Dependencies (with resolution status)
- Implements/relates_to references
- Traceability (implementation refs with file paths)

### 12.10 SHOULD-FIX: Progress Bars Misleading

**Finding:** Active Fleet wireframe shows completion progress bars but only elapsed time is available from dispatch API.
**Resolution:** Replace progress bar with elapsed time display + pulsing activity indicator. No fake progress bars.

### 12.11 SHOULD-FIX: Task Detail Component Consolidation

**Finding:** Three separate task detail implementations exist (inline in tasks page, TaskDetail.svelte, TaskDetailPanel.svelte).
**Resolution:** Phase 2 should consolidate these into a single `TaskDetailModal.svelte` component used everywhere.

### 12.12 SHOULD-FIX: Token Port Scope Underspecified

**Finding:** Plan lists minimal tokens but imgen's contract defines 16 colors, 4 radii, 7 spacing, 7 z-index layers, 3 font families.
**Resolution:** Port the FULL token contract. The `tokens.css` file should map all of imgen's required tokens. The Phase 1 token bridge pilot will validate this approach on one page before broad rollout.

### 12.13 Prototype Plan (from Codex)

Before full implementation, validate with three targeted spikes:

1. **Session stream vertical slice** — Build `GET /api/sessions` + `GET /api/sessions/:id/events`, render one session's structured events. Validates the two-tier streaming approach.
2. **Token bridge pilot** — Map full imgen contract into Tailwind `@theme inline`, restyle one existing page (e.g., dashboard). Validates design system integration.
3. **Kanban data contract spike** — Add `type` + `automation` to task list API, build one kanban column with real data. Validates column mapping.

   668→## 6. Real-Time Architecture
   669→
   670→### 6.1 WebSocket Topics (Existing + New)
   671→
   672→**Existing:**
   673→- `tasks:updates` — task state changes
   674→- `items:updates` — spec changes
   675→- `inbox:updates` — inbox changes
   676→- `meta:updates` — agent/workflow changes
   677→- `validation:updates` — validation state
   678→- `session:updates` — session context
   679→
   680→**Needed for new views:**
   681→- `dispatch:updates` — dispatch start/stop, invocation lifecycle
   682→- `session:stream:{id}` — per-session streaming events (tool calls, messages)
   683→- `triage:updates` — triage record changes (already exists)
   684→
   685→### 6.2 Session Streaming
   686→
   687→For the session stream view, we need to either:
   688→1. **Read session event files** (`.kspec/sessions/{id}/events.jsonl`) via API polling
   689→2. **Stream via WebSocket** — daemon publishes session events to topic
   690→
   691→The daemon likely needs enhancement to support option 2 for true real-time streaming. In the interim, option 1 with polling (every 1-2s for active sessions) provides adequate UX.
   692→
   693→**For dispatch agent output streaming:**
   694→The dispatch engine spawns agents as subprocesses. To stream their output:
   695→- Daemon captures stdout/stderr from spawned agents
   696→- Publishes as `session:stream:{id}` WebSocket events
   697→- UI subscribes to active session streams
   698→- Falls back to event log polling if WS unavailable

   784→## 9. Key Design Decisions
   785→
   786→### 9.1 No Drag-and-Drop Kanban
   787→Tasks transition via agents and CLI commands, not manual dragging. The board is a **visualization**, not a manipulation tool. Users can trigger transitions via buttons in the detail modal (Start, Submit, Complete, Block).
   788→
   789→### 9.2 Active Work Prominence
   790→The Active Fleet row at the top of the task board (and condensed on the dashboard) ensures current agent work is always visible. This addresses the key question: "What are my agents doing right now?"
   791→
   792→### 9.3 Session Stream as Primary Agent View
   793→Rather than trying to replicate a terminal, the session stream uses rich message components (like kynetic-internal's ChatPanel) with markdown rendering, collapsible tool calls, and thinking blocks. This is more readable than raw terminal output.
   794→
   795→### 9.4 Design System Independence
   796→The DS layer (`lib/ds/`) should have zero dependency on kspec business logic. Components are pure presentational. This allows the design system to evolve independently and potentially be extracted.
   797→
   798→### 9.5 Progressive Enhancement
   799→The UI works in both live (daemon connected) and static (snapshot) modes. Write operations are disabled in static mode with clear indicators. This is already implemented but must be maintained through the revamp.

   812→- **kynetic-internal:** ActiveFleetRow, MiniTerminal, ChatPanel, ToolCallView, ThinkingBlock, StreamingMarkdown, kanban columns, session streaming, WebSocket state management
   813→- **Current kspec web UI:** Route structure, API client, WebSocket manager, existing component patterns, Svelte 5 runes usage
   814→
   815→### Technology
   816→- SvelteKit + Svelte 5 (runes: $state, $derived, $effect)
   817→- Tailwind CSS 4 with imgen design tokens mapped as theme extensions (see section 11)
   818→- bits-ui for headless modal/dialog primitives (already in use)
   819→- oklch() color space for perceptual uniformity
   820→
   821→---
   822→
   823→## 11. Review Findings & Revisions
   824→
   825→Critical review performed after initial draft. The following issues were identified and their resolutions documented.
   826→
   827→### 11.1 CRITICAL: Tailwind vs Custom CSS
   828→
   829→**Problem:** The plan originally said "no Tailwind — matches imgen approach." But the entire current web UI is built on Tailwind CSS 4. Every component uses Tailwind classes (`bg-gray-500`, `flex items-center gap-2`). Dependencies include `tailwindcss`, `@tailwindcss/postcss`, `tailwind-merge`, `tailwind-variants`, `tw-animate-css`. Ripping out Tailwind would require rewriting every existing component.
   830→
   831→**Resolution: Keep Tailwind, map imgen tokens as Tailwind theme extensions.** The current `app.css` already uses oklch CSS custom properties that Tailwind consumes via `@theme inline`. imgen's token values will be mapped into this existing system. This is the practical path:
   832→
   833→```css
   834→/* app.css — map imgen tokens to Tailwind theme */
   835→@theme inline {
   836→  --color-design-bg: oklch(0.13 0.01 250);
   837→  --color-design-surface: oklch(0.18 0.01 250);
   838→  --color-design-border: oklch(0.25 0.015 250);
   839→  --color-design-primary: oklch(0.58 0.22 25);
   840→  --color-design-accent: oklch(0.7 0.2 145);
   841→  /* ... etc */
   842→}
   843→```
   844→
   845→Components use Tailwind utilities referencing design tokens: `bg-design-surface`, `border-design-border`, `text-design-accent`. The `ds-` CSS class prefix convention is dropped — not needed since Svelte has built-in component scoping via `<style>` tags.
   846→
   847→### 11.2 Missing Views
   848→
   849→**Workflows view:** Not included in navigation or routes. Daemon serves `GET /api/meta/workflows`. Users need to see active/completed workflows, trigger workflows, and track progress.
   850→
   851→**Resolution:** Add `/workflows` route to section 3.2. Add to sidebar. Components: `WorkflowList.svelte`, `WorkflowDetail.svelte`, `WorkflowStepProgress.svelte`. Store: `workflows.svelte.ts`.
   852→
   853→**Conventions view:** No way to browse project conventions. Conventions are a core meta concept.
   854→
   855→**Resolution:** Add `/settings` route that includes: conventions browser, agent config, project info, shadow branch health, theme switching, daemon connection config.
   856→
   857→**Settings page:** Listed in sidebar wireframe but never defined.
   858→
   859→**Resolution:** Settings serves as the "meta" view — conventions, skills, project config, daemon health. Not a priority for Phase 1 but must be planned.
   860→
   861→### 11.3 API Gaps (Corrected)
   862→
   863→| Endpoint | Plan said | Actual status | Action |
   864→|----------|-----------|---------------|--------|
   865→| Dispatch status | "No endpoint" | **Exists** as `GET /api/agent/dispatch/status` | Fix URL in plan |
   866→| Agent invocations | "No endpoint" | **Partially exists** via `GET /api/agent/status` (returns `active_invocations`) | May need history enrichment |
   867→| Session streaming WS | "Need new topic" | **Already exists**: daemon broadcasts `agent_text_chunk` on `agents` topic with `session_id` | Filter client-side by session_id (simpler) |
   868→| `POST /api/tasks/:ref/note` | "Limited" | **Exists** | Understated in plan |
   869→| Task mutations (submit, complete, block) | Not listed | **Do not exist** | Must build before Phase 2 detail modal |
   870→| `GET /api/sessions` | No endpoint | `listSessions()` exists in `src/sessions/store.ts` but no daemon route | Must build (low effort) |
   871→| `GET /api/sessions/:id/events` | No endpoint | Session events on-disk only (JSONL) | Must build (medium effort) |
   872→| `GET /api/plans` | No endpoint | `loadAllPlans()` exists but no daemon route | Must build (low effort) |
   873→| `GET /api/activity` | No endpoint | Nothing exists | High effort — needs aggregation. Defer to Phase 5 or simplify |
   874→| `automation` in task list | Not in `TaskSummary` | Full task loaded but field not mapped in list response | Trivial fix to daemon |
   875→| `type` in task list | Not in `TaskSummary` | Same — loaded but not returned | Trivial fix to daemon |
   876→
   877→### 11.4 bits-ui Component Duplication
   878→
   879→**Problem:** Plan proposes creating `Modal.svelte`, `Sheet.svelte`, `Accordion.svelte` in `lib/ds/`. But full bits-ui wrapper implementations already exist in `lib/components/ui/dialog/`, `lib/components/ui/sheet/`, `lib/components/ui/accordion/`.
   880→
   881→**Resolution:** Do NOT recreate these. The `lib/ds/` layer should contain only:
   882→- CSS files (tokens, animations, typography)
   883→- Simple presentational components not covered by bits-ui (Card, Badge, Chip, Progress, Skeleton, Terminal, Timeline, Markdown)
   884→- Complex components use bits-ui primitives + design tokens for styling
   885→
   886→### 11.5 Current Web UI Bugs (Quick Wins)
   887→
   888→These should be fixed as prerequisites or Phase 1 items:
   889→
   890→1. **`needs_work` status missing** from `getStatusColor()` and `formatStatus()` in TaskList.svelte and tasks page. Falls through to gray default.
   891→2. **Svelte 4 store** — `taskDetailStore` uses `import { writable, derived, get } from 'svelte/store'` (deprecated API). All other stores use Svelte 5 runes. Migrate before building new stores.
   892→3. **Observations nav item hidden when count is 0** — Sidebar.svelte line 132 only shows "Observe" when `unresolvedObservationsCount > 0`. Should be permanent nav item.
   893→4. **`automation` and `type` fields** not returned in task list API — trivial daemon fix needed before kanban cards.
   894→
   895→### 11.6 UX Gaps
   896→
   897→**Empty states:** Every view needs an empty state design with actionable guidance. Examples:
   898→- Tasks: "No tasks yet. Run `kspec task add --title '...'` or create from a plan."
   899→- Sessions: "No agent sessions recorded. Start dispatch or run an agent manually."
   900→- Inbox: "Inbox is empty. Capture ideas with `kspec inbox add`."
   901→
   902→**Error states:** Need a consistent `ErrorBoundary.svelte` pattern and per-view error handling:
   903→- API timeout on validation (can be slow)
   904→- WebSocket disconnect during active session streaming
   905→- Stale data after reconnection (show warning banner)
   906→
   907→**Loading states:** Must be established in Phase 1, not deferred to Phase 5. Every view built in Phases 2-4 needs loading skeletons from day one.
   908→
   909→**Route rename:** `/items` → `/specs` is a breaking change for existing bookmarks and static exports. Add a redirect from `/items` → `/specs`.
   910→
   911→**Filter persistence:** The kanban board should preserve filter state in URL search params (matching current implementation pattern) so navigation to/from detail doesn't lose context.
   912→
   913→### 11.7 Phase Dependency Corrections
   914→
   915→**Phase 0 (Prerequisites):** Add before Phase 1:
   916→- Fix `needs_work` in status maps
   917→- Add `type` and `automation` to task list API response
   918→- Migrate `taskDetailStore` to Svelte 5 runes
   919→- Make Observations a permanent sidebar item
   920→
   921→**Phase 1 addendum:**
   922→- Resolve Tailwind integration approach (map imgen tokens as theme extensions)
   923→- Establish loading state and error boundary patterns
   924→- Add `/items` → `/specs` redirect
   925→
   926→**Phase 2 addendum:**
   927→- Build task mutation endpoints (submit, complete, block) in daemon — required for detail modal actions
   928→- Decide blocked task presentation: **Resolution: dedicated "Blocked" section below kanban columns** (not a column, not inline — blocked tasks are exceptional and shouldn't take column space)
   929→
   930→**Phase 3 addendum:**
   931→- Build `GET /api/sessions` and `GET /api/sessions/:id/events` daemon routes
   932→- For streaming: use existing `agent_text_chunk` WebSocket events on `agents` topic, filtered client-side by session_id
   933→
   934→**Phase 5: Dashboard simplification:**
   935→- Defer `GET /api/activity` aggregated endpoint. Instead, dashboard "Recent Activity" can poll existing endpoints (recent task transitions, recent session completions) and merge client-side. Simpler to implement, avoids a complex new API.
   936→
   937→### 11.8 Revised Navigation (Final)
   938→
   939→```
   940→/                      → Dashboard (overview)
   941→/tasks                 → Task board (kanban)
   942→/tasks?ref=@slug       → Task board with detail modal open
   943→/specs                 → Spec tree browser (redirect from /items)
   944→/specs?ref=@slug       → Spec tree with detail panel
   945→/agents                → Agent definitions + dispatch status
   946→/sessions              → Session history list
   947→/sessions/:id          → Session detail (chat log)
   948→/inbox                 → Inbox items
   949→/observations          → Observations (friction/success/question/idea)
   950→/triage                → Triage workflow
   951→/plans                 → Plan records
   952→/workflows             → Workflow definitions + active runs (NEW)
   953→/validate              → Validation results + alignment
   954→/settings              → Conventions, skills, project config, health (NEW)
   955→```
   956→
   957→Sidebar groups:
   958→- **Work:** Dashboard, Tasks, Agents, Sessions
   959→- **Specs:** Specs, Plans, Validate
   960→- **Capture:** Inbox, Observations, Triage
   961→- **Config:** Workflows, Settings
   962→
   963→**Note:** Section 3.2 is superseded by this revised navigation. The `/agents/dispatch` sub-route is folded into `/agents`. `/search` is command palette only (no dedicated route).
   964→
   965→---
   966→
   967→## 12. Codex Review Findings & Resolutions
   968→
   969→Codex (gpt-5.3-codex, high reasoning) reviewed the plan against the actual codebase with file-level cross-referencing. 26 findings total.
   970→
   971→### 12.1 MUST-FIX: Internal Route Inconsistency
   972→
   973→**Finding:** Section 3.2 and Section 11.8 define different route sets.
   974→**Resolution:** Section 11.8 is authoritative. Section 3.2 is the original draft — readers should treat 11.8 as the final route table.
   975→
   976→### 12.2 MUST-FIX: Workflow Runs API Missing
   977→
   978→**Finding:** Workflow definitions are served (`GET /api/meta/workflows`) but run data (status, current step, progress) has no API.
   979→**Resolution:** Add to Phase 4 daemon work:
   980→- `GET /api/workflows` — list with run status
   981→- `GET /api/workflows/:id` — detail including step history
   982→- Underlying loader exists (`src/parser/meta.ts:1000-1084`), just needs HTTP route.
   983→
   984→### 12.3 MUST-FIX: WebSocket Topics Inaccurate
   985→
   986→**Finding:** Plan claimed topics that don't exist. Actual topics:
   987→- `tasks:updates` — exists
   988→- `inbox:updates` — exists
   989→- `triage:updates` — exists
   990→- `agents` — exists (dispatch events including `agent_text_chunk`)
   991→- File watcher topics — exist
   992→- `items:updates`, `meta:updates`, `validation:updates`, `session:updates` — **DO NOT EXIST**
   993→
   994→**Resolution:** Corrected in plan. New views that need real-time updates for items/meta/validation will either:
   995→(a) Subscribe to file watcher topics and refresh on relevant file changes, or
   996→(b) Poll on a reasonable interval (30s for validation, immediate for user-triggered actions).
   997→
   998→### 12.4 MUST-FIX: Session Streaming — Text-Only vs Structured
   999→
  1000→**Finding:** `agent_text_chunk` events are plain text. The plan's rich wireframe (tool calls, thinking blocks, collapsible output) can't be rendered from text chunks alone.
  1001→
  1002→**Resolution:** Two-tier approach:
  1003→1. **Historical sessions:** Read `events.jsonl` via new `GET /api/sessions/:id/events` endpoint. JSONL contains structured events (tool calls, messages, thinking) with full type info.
  1004→2. **Live sessions:** Use `agent_text_chunk` for live text streaming (shows raw agent output). For structured view, poll `events.jsonl` periodically (2-3s) to get structured events as they're appended.
  1005→3. **Future enhancement:** Daemon could publish structured session events on a dedicated WS topic. This is a daemon feature, not UI work, and can be added later.
  1006→
  1007→The session stream view should support both modes: "Live text" (raw streaming) and "Structured" (parsed from event log). Default to structured for completed sessions, live text for active sessions with periodic structured refresh.
  1008→
  1009→### 12.5 MUST-FIX: `cancelled` Status Missing from Kanban
  1010→
  1011→**Finding:** `cancelled` is a valid task state not mapped to any kanban column.
  1012→**Resolution:** Add "Cancelled" handling — cancelled tasks appear in the "Done" column with a distinct visual (strikethrough title, gray badge). They are collapsed by default (like Archive in kynetic-internal) or filterable.
  1013→
  1014→### 12.6 MUST-FIX: Phases Don't Cover New Views
  1015→
  1016→**Finding:** Workflows and Settings were added in section 11 but not assigned to any phase.
  1017→**Resolution:**
  1018→- **Workflows view:** Phase 4 (alongside Plans and Validation)
  1019→- **Settings view:** Phase 4 (minimal: conventions list, project info, shadow health)
  1020→- **Settings detail:** Phase 5 (editable conventions, skill management, theme switching)
  1021→
  1022→### 12.7 MUST-FIX: Accessibility Underspecified
  1023→
  1024→**Finding:** Complex modals, live streams, and keyboard-heavy views need concrete accessibility requirements, not just a Phase 5 audit.
  1025→
  1026→**Resolution:** Accessibility requirements per view type:
  1027→- **Modals:** Focus trap (bits-ui handles this), escape to close, return focus to trigger
  1028→- **Live stream:** `aria-live="polite"` region, pause/resume controls, keyboard scrolling
  1029→- **Kanban:** Column landmarks with heading, card announced with status + title
  1030→- **Triage:** Keyboard shortcuts with visible hints, `aria-keyshortcuts` attributes
  1031→- **Status badges:** Not color-only — include text labels (already done in current UI)
  1032→- **All animations:** `prefers-reduced-motion` gated (from imgen convention)
  1033→
  1034→These are per-phase requirements, not deferred to Phase 5.
  1035→
  1036→### 12.8 SHOULD-FIX: Task Detail Missing Schema Fields
  1037→
  1038→**Finding:** Task detail modal wireframe omits `plan_ref`, `review_url`, `vcs_refs`, `session_id`, `context`.
  1039→**Resolution:** Updated task detail modal spec:
  1040→- **VCS:** Show branch name + PR link (from `vcs_refs` and `review_url`)
  1041→- **Plan:** Link to plan (if `plan_ref` set)
  1042→- **Session:** Link to last session (if `session_id` set)
  1043→- **Context:** Show if present (typically dispatch context)
  1044→- `meta_ref` is internal, not displayed
  1045→
  1046→### 12.9 SHOULD-FIX: Spec Detail Missing Relationship Fields
  1047→
  1048→**Finding:** `depends_on`, `implements`, `relates_to`, `traceability` not in wireframe.
  1049→**Resolution:** Add "Relationships" section to spec detail panel showing:
  1050→- Dependencies (with resolution status)
  1051→- Implements/relates_to references
  1052→- Traceability (implementation refs with file paths)
  1053→
  1054→### 12.10 SHOULD-FIX: Progress Bars Misleading
  1055→
  1056→**Finding:** Active Fleet wireframe shows completion progress bars but only elapsed time is available from dispatch API.
  1057→**Resolution:** Replace progress bar with elapsed time display + pulsing activity indicator. No fake progress bars.
  1058→
  1059→### 12.11 SHOULD-FIX: Task Detail Component Consolidation
  1060→
  1061→**Finding:** Three separate task detail implementations exist (inline in tasks page, TaskDetail.svelte, TaskDetailPanel.svelte).
  1062→**Resolution:** Phase 2 should consolidate these into a single `TaskDetailModal.svelte` component used everywhere.
  1063→
  1064→### 12.12 SHOULD-FIX: Token Port Scope Underspecified
  1065→
  1066→**Finding:** Plan lists minimal tokens but imgen's contract defines 16 colors, 4 radii, 7 spacing, 7 z-index layers, 3 font families.
  1067→**Resolution:** Port the FULL token contract. The `tokens.css` file should map all of imgen's required tokens. The Phase 1 token bridge pilot will validate this approach on one page before broad rollout.
  1068→
  1069→### 12.13 Prototype Plan (from Codex)
  1070→
  1071→Before full implementation, validate with three targeted spikes:
  1072→
  1073→1. **Session stream vertical slice** — Build `GET /api/sessions` + `GET /api/sessions/:id/events`, render one session's structured events. Validates the two-tier streaming approach.
  1074→2. **Token bridge pilot** — Map full imgen contract into Tailwind `@theme inline`, restyle one existing page (e.g., dashboard). Validates design system integration.
  1075→3. **Kanban data contract spike** — Add `type` + `automation` to task list API, build one kanban column with real data. Validates column mapping.
  1076→
  1077→### 12.14 Full Codex Review
  1078→
  1079→Complete Codex review with all 26 findings saved at `/tmp/codex-plan-review.md`.
  1080→

import DOMPurify from 'isomorphic-dompurify';

marked.setOptions({
	gfm: true,
	breaks: true
});

/**
 * Render markdown string to sanitized HTML.
 * Uses marked for parsing and DOMPurify for XSS protection.
 */
export function renderMarkdown(content: string): string {
	if (!content) return '';
	const rawHtml = marked.parse(content, { async: false }) as string;
	return DOMPurify.sanitize(rawHtml, {
		ADD_ATTR: ['target'],
		ALLOWED_TAGS: [
			'p',
			'br',
			'strong',
			'em',
			'del',
			'code',
			'pre',
			'blockquote',
			'ul',
			'ol',
			'li',
			'a',
			'h1',
			'h2',
			'h3',
			'h4',
			'h5',
			'h6',
			'hr',
			'table',
			'thead',
			'tbody',
			'tr',
			'th',
			'td',
			'img',
			'span',
			'div',
			'input'

		ALLOWED_ATTR: [
			'href',
			'target',
			'rel',
			'src',
			'alt',
			'title',
			'class',
			'type',
			'checked',
			'disabled'
		]
	});
}

<!--
  AC: @ui-task-board ac-3 — Task detail modal with full task info.
  AC: @ui-task-board ac-6 — Action buttons: Start, Submit, Complete, Block, Add Note.
-->
<script lang="ts">
	import type { TaskDetail } from '@kynetic-ai/shared';
	import {
		fetchTask,
		startTask,
		submitTask,
		completeTask,
		blockTask,
		addTaskNote
	} from '$lib/api';
	import { isStaticMode, ReadOnlyModeError } from '$lib/stores/mode.svelte';
	import * as Dialog from '$lib/components/ui/dialog';
	import { Badge } from '$lib/components/ui/badge';
	import { Button } from '$lib/components/ui/button';
	import { Textarea } from '$lib/components/ui/textarea';
	import { Input } from '$lib/components/ui/input';
	import { Separator } from '$lib/components/ui/separator';
	import { Skeleton } from '$lib/components/ui/skeleton';
	import ReferenceLink from '$lib/components/ReferenceLink.svelte';
	import { getStatusClasses, formatAge, formatVcsRef } from './board-utils';
	import GitBranch from '@lucide/svelte/icons/git-branch';
	import ExternalLink from '@lucide/svelte/icons/external-link';

	let {
		open = $bindable(false),
		taskRef = $bindable<string | null>(null),
		onTaskUpdated
	}: {
		open?: boolean;
		taskRef?: string | null;
		onTaskUpdated?: () => void;
	} = $props();

	let task = $state<TaskDetail | null>(null);
	let loading = $state(false);
	let error = $state('');
	let actionError = $state('');
	let isSubmitting = $state(false);

	// Note form
	let noteContent = $state('');

	// Block/Complete reason form
	let reasonInput = $state('');
	let showReasonFor = $state<'block' | 'complete' | null>(null);

	$effect(() => {
		if (open && taskRef) {
			loadTask(taskRef);
		} else if (!open) {
			task = null;
			error = '';
			actionError = '';
			noteContent = '';
			reasonInput = '';
			showReasonFor = null;
		}
	});

	async function loadTask(ref: string) {
		loading = true;
		error = '';
		try {
			task = await fetchTask(ref);
		} catch (err) {
			error = err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Failed to load task';
		} finally {
			loading = false;
		}
	}

	async function reloadAndNotify() {
		if (task) {
			task = await fetchTask(task._ulid);
		}
		onTaskUpdated?.();
	}

	async function handleAction(action: () => Promise<void>) {
		isSubmitting = true;
		actionError = '';
		try {
			await action();
			await reloadAndNotify();
		} catch (err) {
			if (err instanceof ReadOnlyModeError) {
				actionError = err.message;
			} else {
				actionError = err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Action failed';
			}
		} finally {
			isSubmitting = false;
		}
	}

	function handleStart() {
		if (!task) return;
		handleAction(() => startTask(task!._ulid));
	}

	function handleSubmit() {
		if (!task) return;
		handleAction(() => submitTask(task!._ulid));
	}

	function handleComplete() {
		if (!task || !reasonInput.trim()) return;
		const reason = reasonInput.trim();
		handleAction(async () => {
			await completeTask(task!._ulid, reason);
			reasonInput = '';
			showReasonFor = null;
		});
	}

	function handleBlock() {
		if (!task || !reasonInput.trim()) return;
		const reason = reasonInput.trim();
		handleAction(async () => {
			await blockTask(task!._ulid, reason);
			reasonInput = '';
			showReasonFor = null;
		});
	}

	function handleAddNote() {
		if (!task || !noteContent.trim()) return;
		const content = noteContent.trim();
		handleAction(async () => {
			await addTaskNote(task!._ulid, content);
			noteContent = '';
		});
	}

	function formatDate(dateStr: string): string {
		return new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', {
			month: 'short',
			day: 'numeric',
			hour: '2-digit',
			minute: '2-digit'
		}).format(new Date(dateStr));
	}

	let statusInfo = $derived(task ? getStatusClasses(task.status) : null);
	let slug = $derived(task?.slugs?.[0] ?? task?._ulid?.slice(0, 8) ?? '');
</script>

 * Render markdown string to sanitized HTML.
 * Uses marked for parsing and DOMPurify for XSS protection.

export function renderMarkdown(content: string): string {
	if (!content) return '';
	const rawHtml = marked.parse(content, { async: false }) as string;
	return DOMPurify.sanitize(rawHtml, {
		ADD_ATTR: ['target'],
		ALLOWED_TAGS: [
			'p',
			'br',
			'strong',
			'em',
			'del',

	};
}
